title: Warm Lemon Garlic Mashed Beans
summary: A simple Middle Eastern-style vegan breakfast of warm mashed beans brightened with lemon, garlic, and cumin. It’s creamy, savoury, and comforting, great with bread or flatbread.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cumin and cook for about 30 seconds, just until fragrant.
Add the cannellini beans, lemon juice, vegetable stock, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until the beans are hot.
Mash the beans with a fork or potato masher, leaving some texture. If they seem too thick, add a splash more stock and stir.
Taste and adjust with more lemon or salt if needed. Spoon into bowls and finish with chopped parsley. Serve warm.
